description.value: Xpress Donair House is a halal donair restaurant in Maple Ridge specializing in lamb donairs served with mixed veggies, wrapped, and specialty sauces. It is one of two Lower Mainland locations and positions itself as a quick, accessible stop with partnerships across major food delivery platforms. Cyclists passing through Maple Ridge on Lougheed Highway will find it a convenient refuelling option for a filling, protein-rich meal.
